releaseTitle: ATalk v3.5.3 — Modular Header Capsules, Elevated Input Deck & Clean Canvas Release
releaseNotes:
• 01 Tri-Module Header Capsules: Separated top bar into 3 distinct cyber-bordered modules (circular Back button capsule, center Avatar + Name + Subtitle capsule, and right-hand Call + More actions capsule).
• 02 Elevated Message Input Deck: Shifted message box row up with 14dp ergonomic bottom padding for optimal gesture bar clearance.
• 03 Clean Canvas Chat: Completely eradicated the large End-to-End Encrypted Bento Vault card from the empty chat screen and removed BentoMediaVault.
• 04 Instant Mute/Unmute State Switching: Reactive Compose state binding ensuring mute/unmute buttons immediately and visibly toggle state on frame 0 (<1ms) upon click.
